vocab_words.meaning: hậu cần, công tác vận chuyển
vocab_words.example: The logistics team coordinates all deliveries.
The factory upgraded its assembly line last year.
The company plans to upgrade its software system.
A malfunction caused the server to shut down.
All data is protected by strong encryption.
The technician helped troubleshoot the network issue.
The new printer is compatible with most devices.
Customer records are stored in a secure database.
The company went from near bankruptcy to a high level of profitability

items.question: The committee is reviewing several proposals ___ improving workplace safety.
items.explanation: Cụm "proposals for + V-ing" nghĩa là đề xuất nhằm mục đích gì.

items.question: The new policy will take effect ___ the beginning of next month.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "at the beginning of" dùng giới từ "at".

items.question: The manager, along with two assistants, ___ attending the conference.
items.explanation: Cụm "along with..." không ảnh hưởng tới động từ, chia theo chủ ngữ chính số ít "the manager".

items.question: The results of the survey were ___ surprising to the marketing team.
items.explanation: "Quite" là trạng từ nghĩa "khá", bổ nghĩa cho tính từ "surprising".

items.question: The airline apologized ___ the inconvenience caused by the delay.
The client requested that the invoice ___ sent by email.
items.explanation: Câu giả định (subjunctive) sau "request that" dùng động từ nguyên mẫu "be".

items.question: Please make sure the report is ___ accurate before submission.
items.explanation: Cần trạng từ để bổ nghĩa cho tính từ "accurate".

items.question: If the shipment ___ on time, we will lose the client.
items.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 1: If + hiện tại đơn, mệnh đề chính dùng will.

items.question: The manager insisted that the report ___ revised before submission.
items.explanation: Sau "insist that" trong câu giả định trang trọng, dùng động từ nguyên mẫu "be".

items.question: Customers can track their orders ___ our new mobile application.
items.explanation: "Through" nghĩa là thông qua, bằng phương tiện gì.
